outcome: Deliver the DiceBox Campaign Helper product through ordered acceptance gates, including vision-assisted but GM-approved Spatial Blueprint proposals, beginning with a subscription-backed AI provider spine and continuing through real project authoring, conversation, approval, Foundry control, diagnostics, campaign content, image providers, and release.
acceptanceObservation: The packaged desktop creates and manages real campaign projects, provides bounded conversational assistance through managed ChatGPT by default with an explicit API-key backup, authors and compiles semantic content, can turn approved known-size map observations into editable grid-aligned geometry proposals without granting pixels authority, controls exact Foundry operations through approval and reread, and remains usable when AI is offline.
scopeBoundary: One ordered product stage at a time. Stage 8 real project and multi-Scene workspace is accepted on bounded local evidence; the active stage is now the Foundry execution/evidence foundation. Vision-assisted Spatial Blueprint implementation, conversational AI expansion, broader authoring, Foundry control, campaign content, image promotion, Tram, Ballad, and release work remain pending until their gates become active. The accepted vision workflow may be recorded and reconciled now, but product implementation remains assigned to the existing Stage 9 evidence, Stage 12 authoring, and Stage 15 provider gates. Stage 8 closure does not certify alpha readiness, Foundry behavior, universal durability, unsupported migration, cleanup, or later stages.
